WITH word_synset AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sense_count
  FROM senses s
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, sense_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sense_count DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM word_synset
),
top_synset AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid AS top_synsetid, sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
word_stats AS (
  SELECT s.wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets,
       ws.total_senses,
       ws.distinct_domains,
       ws.distinct_posids,
       t.top_synsetid,
       t.top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN top_synset t ON t.wordid = ws.wordid
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC,
         ws.total_synsets DESC,
         ws.distinct_domains DESC,
         w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
